archetypes.name: dyn-step4-mode
archetypes.rationale: Step 3b now owns Step 4 mode selection and marker ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Step 3b finalize wrapper and SKILL.md Step 4 prose. Focus on failure ordering, stdout cleanliness, sidecar durability, and resume@4 behavior. Check that probe failures cannot leave a misleading step-3b completion marker or stale STEP4_MODE route. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-settle-contract
archetypes.rationale: Settle routing authority moved from rc fallback prose to action-row-only dispatch.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the settle dispatch reference and its callers in SKILL.md, approval-gates.md, and discussion-rounds.md. Verify the action-row-only contract is consistent with existing wrapper rc behavior and that missing or disagreeing action rows fail closed without losing diagnostic value. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-structure-pins
archetypes.rationale: Structural harness pins were rewritten for deleted prose and new mode handoff.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review scripts/test-design-structure.sh and test-gate-b-apply-mode.sh. Ensure the new positive and negative assertions cover the removed fallback tables, Step 3 entry fence deduplication, Gate B bypass collapse, and Step 3b STEP4_MODE handoff without overfitting unrelated prose. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
